aether_bindings_of_the_third_age.name_en: Aether Bindings of the Third Age
aether_bindings_of_the_third_age.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁此牌：直到回合结束，每当你控制的名称中含有印记的光环永久物离开竞技场时，增幅1。
战痕
aether_bindings_of_the_third_age.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: Until end of turn, whenever an aura permanent you control with Sigil in its name leaves the arena, amp 1.
Battleworn

apex_bonebreaker.text_zh:
当此牌与一张力量为6或更高的牌一起防御时，创造一个力量衍生物。
淬炼
apex_bonebreaker.text_en:
When this defends together with a card with 6 or more {p}, create a Might token.
Temper

aqua_laps.text_zh:
翳装
攻击反应——支付1点资源，将此牌翻为正面朝上：目标攻击获得再动。
在你的回合开始时，摧毁此牌。
aqua_laps.text_en:
Cloaked
Attack Reaction - {r}, turn this face up: Target attack gets go again.
At the start of your turn, destroy this.

arcbane_grasp.type_zh: 机械师 瞬间 装备·Evo Base 手臂
arcbane_grasp.text_zh:
若你装备了一件基础手臂装备，将其转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。
当此牌被装备时，创造一个法殁神盾衍生物。
奥术屏障1
arcbane_grasp.text_en:
If you have a base arms equipped, transform it into this, then equip this.
When this is equipped, create a Spellbane Aegis token.
Arcane Barrier 1

瞬间——摧毁此牌：抽一张牌。仅当对手本回合抽过两张或更多牌时才能启动。
守御
balance_of_justice.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: Draw a card. Activate this only if an opponent has drawn 2 or more cards this turn.
Guardwell

barkskin_of_the_millennium_tree.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，若你的放逐区有四张或更多大地牌，创造一个大地化身衍生物。
淬炼
barkskin_of_the_millennium_tree.text_en:
When this defends, if there are 4 or more Earth cards in your banished zone, create an Embodiment of Earth token.
Temper

basalt_boots.text_zh:
若你控制一个地震涌动衍生物，此牌获得+1防御。
淬炼
basalt_boots.text_en:
If you control a Seismic Surge token, this gets +1{d}.
Temper

blacktek_whisperers.text_zh:
当黑泰克低语者在你坟场中时，在你的回合开始时，你可以摧毁你控制的2个银币。若如此做，装备黑泰克低语者。
攻击反应——摧毁黑泰克低语者：目标刺客攻击行动牌获得“当此牌命中英雄时，它获得再动。”
战痕

While Blacktek Whisperers is in your graveyard, at the start of your turn, you may destroy 2 Silvers you control. If you do, equip Blacktek Whisperers.
Attack Reaction - Destroy Blacktek Whisperers: Target Assassin attack action card gains "When this hits a hero, it gains go again."
Battleworn

blitz_kicks.text_zh:
瞬间——支付1点资源，摧毁此牌：创造一个闪电化身衍生物。仅当本回合你使用过一张瞬间牌时才能启动此异能。
奥术屏障1
blitz_kicks.text_en:
Instant - {r}, destroy this: Create an Embodiment of Lightning token. Activate this only if you've played an instant card this turn.
Arcane Barrier 1

blizzard.text_zh: 目标攻击失去且不能获得再动，除非其操控者支付2点资源。
blizzard.text_en: Target attack loses and can't gain go again unless its controller pays {r}{r}.

boltn_boots.text_zh:
攻击反应——支付1点资源，摧毁此牌：目标力量大于其基础的箭矢攻击获得再动。
战痕
boltn_boots.text_en:
Attack Reaction - {r}, destroy this: Target arrow attack with {p} greater than its base gets go again.
Battleworn

boots_of_omnis_ward.text_zh:
若你本回合受到过奥术伤害，此牌获得+1防御。
瞬间——横置你的英雄，摧毁此牌：防止本回合接下来将对你造成的1点伤害。
淬炼
boots_of_omnis_ward.text_en:
If you've been dealt arcane damage this turn, this gets +1{d}.
Instant - {t} your hero, destroy this: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn.
Temper

boots_to_the_boards.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，支付至多3点资源。创造等量的坚韧衍生物。
淬炼
boots_to_the_boards.text_en:
When this defends, pay up to {r}{r}{r}. Create that many Toughness tokens.
Temper

boulder_drop.text_en: Crush - When this deals 4 or more damage to a hero, they put a card from their hand on top of their deck.

breeze_rider_boots.text_zh:
当你控制的忍者攻击行动牌命中时，你可以摧毁乘风之靴。若如此做，本回合具有连击的攻击行动牌获得再动。
战痕
breeze_rider_boots.text_en:
When a Ninja attack action card you control hits, you may destroy Breeze Rider Boots. If you do, attack action cards with combo gain go again this turn.
Battleworn

bulls_eye_bracers.text_zh:
行动——摧毁牛眼护腕：若你军械库中没有牌，你可以将你手牌中的一张箭矢正面朝上放入你的军械库。它直到回合结束获得+1力量。再动
奥术屏障1
bulls_eye_bracers.text_en:
Action - Destroy Bull's Eye Bracers: If you have no cards in your arsenal, you may put an arrow card from your hand face up into your arsenal. It gains +1{p} until end of turn. Go again
Arcane Barrier 1

channel_iceloch_glaze.text_zh:
再动
当对手控制霜咬衍生物或冻结的永久物时，其军械库中的牌处于冻结状态。
引导冰霜——在你的结束阶段开始时，在此牌上放置一个流动指示物，然后除非你为其上的每个流动指示物将一张冰牌从资源区置于牌库底，否则摧毁此牌。
channel_iceloch_glaze.text_en:
Go again
Cards in opponents' arsenals are frozen while they control a Frostbite or a frozen permanent.
Channel Ice - At the beginning of your end phase, put a flow counter on this, then destroy it unless you put an Ice card from your pitch zone on the bottom of your deck for each flow counter on it.

channel_lake_frigid.text_zh:
再动
牌和启动的异能对对手英雄而言额外消耗1点资源。
引导冰霜——在你的结束阶段开始时，在严寒湖上放置一个流动指示物，然后除非你为其上的每个流动指示物将一张冰牌从资源区置于牌库底，否则摧毁严寒湖。
channel_lake_frigid.text_en:
Go again
Cards and activated abilities cost opposing heroes an additional {r}.
Channel Ice - At the beginning of your end phase, put a flow counter on Channel Lake Frigid then destroy it unless you put an Ice card from your pitch zone on the bottom of your deck for each flow counter on it.

civic_guide.text_zh:
每当此牌防御时，在另一位英雄的控制下创造一个力量衍生物。

Whenever this defends, create a Might token under another hero's control.
Temper

civic_peak.text_zh:
每当此牌防御时，另一位目标英雄抽一张牌。

civic_peak.text_en:
Whenever this defends, another target hero draws a card.
Temper

每当观众为你欢呼时，若你的生命低于其他每位英雄，你可以摧毁此牌。若如此做，获得1个行动点。
战痕
comeback_kicks.text_en:
Whenever the crowd cheers you, if you have less {h} than each other hero, you may destroy this. If you do, gain 1 action point.
Battleworn

行动——支付1点资源，摧毁二分王冠：将你坟场中的目标符文剑士攻击行动牌和目标符文剑士“非攻击”行动牌以任意顺序置于你的牌库顶。

Action - {r}, destroy Crown of Dichotomy: Put target Runeblade attack action card and target Runeblade 'non-attack' action card from your graveyard on top of your deck in any order.
Arcane Barrier 1

crown_of_everbloom.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁此牌：将你军械库中的一张牌置于牌库底。若如此做，抽一张牌并创造一个法殁神盾衍生物。

crown_of_everbloom.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: Put a card from your arsenal on the bottom of your deck. If you do, draw a card and create a Spellbane Aegis token.
Arcane Barrier 2

crown_of_frozen_thoughts.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，冻结攻击英雄直到其下一个回合开始。

When this defends, freeze the attacking hero until the start of their next turn.
Blade Break

crown_of_reflection.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁反思之冠：摧毁你控制的目标幻术师光环。若如此做，你可以将你手牌中一张费用小于或等于以此方式摧毁的光环的幻术师光环牌放入竞技场。仅能在你的行动阶段期间启动反思之冠。
奥术屏障1
crown_of_reflection.text_en:
Instant - Destroy Crown of Reflection: Destroy target Illusionist aura you control. If you do, you may put an Illusionist aura card from your hand into the arena with cost less than or equal the aura destroyed this way. Activate Crown of Reflection only during your action phase.

crown_of_seeds.text_zh: 每回合一次瞬间——支付1点资源，将你军械库中的一张牌面朝下的牌置于你的牌库底：抽一张牌，并防止本回合接下来将对你的英雄造成的1点伤害。
crown_of_seeds.text_en: Once per Turn Instant - {r}, put a face down card from your arsenal on the bottom of your deck: Draw a card and prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to your hero this turn.

crumble_to_eternity.text_zh:
贾尔专精
当此牌进入竞技场时，你可以在一个装备上放置一个-1防御指示物。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌，然后你本回合的下一次攻击获得支配。
crumble_to_eternity.text_en:
Jarl Specialization
When this enters the arena, you may put a -1{d} counter on an equipment.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this, then your next attack this turn gets dominate.

dance_of_darkness.text_zh:
若你的英雄将受到伤害，你可以放逐此牌以防止其中2点伤害。

dance_of_darkness.text_en:
If your hero would be dealt damage, you may banish this to prevent 2 of that damage.
Blood Debt

攻击反应——支付2点资源，摧毁此牌：目标已下注的攻击获得+1力量。

dealers_grip.text_en:
Attack Reaction - {r}{r}, destroy this: Target attack that has wagered gets +1{p}.

在你的结束阶段开始时，若你手牌中有4张或更多牌，创造一个钻石衍生物。

diamond_hands.text_en:
Ruu'di Specialization
At the beginning of your end phase, if you have 4 or more cards in hand, create a Diamond token.
Blade Break

瞬间——支付3点资源，摧毁此牌：目标龙裔攻击获得再动。若其为武器或盟友攻击，本回合你可以用它额外攻击一次。每当你控制一个龙裔链环，此异能费用减少1点资源。

dragonscaler_flight_path.text_en:
Instant - {r}{r}{r}, destroy this: Target Draconic attack gets go again. If it's a weapon or ally attack, you may attack with it an additional time this turn. This ability costs {r} less to activate for each Draconic chain link you control.
Battleworn

行动——摧毁织梦者：本回合你使用的下一张幻术师攻击行动牌失去且不能获得虚击。再动

dream_weavers.text_en:
Action - Destroy Dream Weavers: The next Illusionist attack action card you play this turn loses and can't gain phantasm. Go again

Whenever you banish a Hyper Driver from boosting, remove a -1{d} counter from this.

duelist_gauntlets.text_en:
Attack Reaction - {r}, destroy this: Target sword attack gets "Reaction cards get -1{d} while defending this."

战痕
edge_laden_plate.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: Gain {r}. Activate this only if you've sharpened a sword this turn.
Battleworn

融合
选择坟场中一张费用小于你本回合获得生命总量的行动牌，将它置于其拥有者的牌库底。
再动
//
获得1点生命。

若你装备了一件基础胸部装备，将其和你控制的X张超频驱动器转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。若如此做，本回合接下来你将受到伤害时，防止其中两倍X的伤害。
每当你推进时，你可以摧毁此牌之下的一张牌。若如此做，获得2点资源。
evo_atom_breaker.text_en:
If you have a base chest equipped, transform it and X Hyper Drivers you control into this, then equip this. If you do, the next time you would be dealt damage this turn, prevent twice X of that damage.
Whenever you boost, you may destroy a card under this. If you do, gain {r}{r}.

evo_face_breaker.type_zh: 机械师 瞬间 装备·Evo 手臂

若你装备了一件基础手臂装备，将其和你控制的X张超频驱动器转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。若如此做，本回合接下来你将受到伤害时，防止其中两倍X的伤害。
每当你推进一张攻击行动牌时，你可以摧毁此牌之下的一张牌。若如此做，该攻击获得+2力量。
evo_face_breaker.text_en:
If you have a base arms equipped, transform it and X Hyper Drivers you control into this, then equip this. If you do, the next time you would be dealt damage this turn, prevent twice X of that damage.
Whenever you boost an attack action card, you may destroy a card under this. If you do, the attack gets +2{p}.

evo_mach_breaker.type_zh: 机械师 瞬间 装备·Evo 腿部

若你装备了一件基础腿部装备，将其和你控制的X张超频驱动器转化为此牌，然后装备此牌。若如此做，本回合接下来你将受到伤害时，防止其中两倍X的伤害。
每当你推进时，你可以摧毁此牌之下的一张牌。若如此做，创造一个加速衍生物。
evo_mach_breaker.text_en:
If you have a base legs equipped, transform it and X Hyper Drivers you control into this, then equip this. If you do, the next time you would be dealt damage this turn, prevent twice X of that damage.
Whenever you boost, you may destroy a card under this. If you do, create a Quicken token.

When this defends together with an attack action card and a non-attack action card, the attacking hero discards a card and you draw a card.
Blade Break

若你的放逐区有四张或更多大地牌，此牌获得+4力量。
分解——当此牌攻击时，你可以放逐坟场中的两张大地牌和一张行动牌。若如此做，每位英雄将手牌中的一张牌置于其牌库底。
felling_of_the_crown.text_en:
If there are 4 or more Earth cards in your banished zone, this gets +4{p}.
Decompose - When this attacks, you may banish 2 Earth cards and an action card from your graveyard. If you do, each hero puts a card from their hand on the bottom of their deck.

fiddlers_green.text_zh: 当此牌从任何区域置入你的坟场时，获得3点生命。
fiddlers_green.text_en: When this is put into your graveyard from anywhere, gain 3{h}.

fingers_of_fragmentation.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}, destroy this: Target attack action card that has fragmented gets +2{p}.

行动——支付1点资源，摧毁此牌：你本回合的下一次攻击获得+1力量。再动

Action - {r}, destroy this: Your next attack this turn gets +1{p}. Go again

frozen_to_death.text_en:
Ice Fusion
If this was fused, you may destroy an equipment with a -1{d} counter.
You may create a Frostbite token in an exposed head, chest, arms, or legs zone.

fruits_of_the_forest.text_zh: 瞬间——弃掉此牌：获得2点生命。

galvanic_bender.text_en:
Material - While this is under a permanent, that permanent has +1{p}.

gauntlet_of_boulderhold.text_en:
Action - {r}{r}{r}, destroy this: The next Guardian attack action card you play from arsenal this turn gets +2{p}. Go again

每回合一次行动——支付2点资源：若以此方式弃置的是大地牌，你本回合名称为“绞碎”的攻击获得+2力量；若是冰牌，你本回合名称为“绞碎”的攻击获得支配。再动

Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}: If an Earth card is pitched this way, your attacks named Mangle get +2{p} this turn. If an Ice card is pitched this way, your attacks named Mangle get dominate this turn. Go again

At the beginning of your end phase, destroy Spellbound Creepers unless you have dealt arcane damage equal to or greater than the number of bind counters on Spellbound Creepers.
Blade Break
